    "walls": { "thickness_mm": 200 },
    "slabs": { "thickness_mm": 150 },
    "windows": { "dimensions": { "width_mm": 1200, "height_mm": 1000, "sill_height_mm": 900 } }

    { "path": "/known_facts/slabs/thickness_mm", "source_turns": ["turn-user-009"], "evidence_refs": ["capability:IFC2X3:IfcSlab"] },
    { "path": "/known_facts/windows/dimensions", "source_turns": ["turn-user-013"], "evidence_refs": ["capability:IFC2X3:IfcWindow"] }
  ],
  "missing_facts": [
    {
      "id": "mf-floor-plan-dimensions",
      "code": "FLOOR_PLAN_MISSING",
      "path": "/known_facts/floor_plan/length_mm",

      "blocking": true,
      "evidence_refs": ["schema:bim-json-v2:representation", "capability:IFC2X3:IfcSpace"],
      "source_turns": ["turn-user-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "mf-storey-height",
      "code": "STOREY_HEIGHT_MISSING",
      "path": "/known_facts/storey_height_mm",
      "message": "层高尚未确定。",
      "reason": "需要定义每层的高度。",
      "blocking": true,
      "evidence_refs": ["capability:IFC2X3:IfcBuildingStorey"],
      "source_turns": ["turn-user-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "mf-stair-location",
      "code": "STAIR_LOCATION_MISSING",
      "path": "/known_facts/stair/location",
      "message": "楼梯位置尚未确定。",
      "reason": "需要知道楼梯在平面中的位置。",
      "blocking": true,
      "evidence_refs": ["capability:IFC2X3:IfcStair"],
      "source_turns": ["turn-user-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "mf-door-sizes",
      "code": "DOOR_SIZES_MISSING",
      "path": "/known_facts/doors/sizes",
      "message": "门的宽度和高度尚未确定。",
      "reason": "用户未提供门尺寸。",
      "blocking": true,
      "evidence_refs": ["capability:IFC2X3:IfcDoor"],
      "source_turns": ["turn-user-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "mf-window-location",
      "code": "WINDOW_LOCATION_MISSING",
      "path": "/known_facts/windows/location",
      "message": "窗的位置（所在的墙面）尚未确定。",
      "reason": "用户未提供窗的宿主墙。",
      "blocking": true,
      "evidence_refs": ["capability:IFC2X3:IfcWindow"],
      "source_turns": ["turn-user-001"]
    }
  ],
  "ambiguities": [],
  "unsupported_requests": [],
  "user_corrections": [],
  "clarification_questions": [
    {
      "id": "q-floor-plan-height",
      "text": "请提供一层住宅的平面尺寸（长度和宽度）以及层高是多少？",
      "targets": ["mf-floor-plan-dimensions", "mf-storey-height"],
      "reason": "需要这些尺寸才能生成空间和楼层。",
      "evidence_refs": ["schema:bim-json-v2:representation", "capability:IFC2X3:IfcSpace", "capability:IFC2X3:IfcBuildingStorey"]
    },
    {
      "id": "q-stair-location",
      "text": "楼梯的位置在哪里？（例如，在哪个房间或轴网位置）",
      "targets": ["mf-stair-location"],
      "reason": "需要知道楼梯在平面中的位置。",
      "evidence_refs": ["capability:IFC2X3:IfcStair"]
    },
    {
      "id": "q-openings",
      "text": "请提供门（入户门和室内门）的尺寸（宽度和高度）以及窗的位置（所在的墙面或轴网）。如果暂时不知道，可以告诉我。",
      "targets": ["mf-door-sizes", "mf-window-location"],
      "reason": "需要门尺寸和窗位置才能生成洞口和填充构件。",
      "evidence_refs": ["capability:IFC2X3:IfcDoor", "capability:IFC2X3:IfcWindow"]

      "capability:IFC2X3:IfcDoor",
      "capability:IFC2X3:IfcWindow",
      "capability:IFC2X3:IfcStair"
    ],
    "source_turns": ["turn-user-001", "turn-user-005", "turn-user-009", "turn-user-013"]
  }
}

根据few-shot，我们应当只问阻塞的事实。列出所有缺失事实及其阻塞性：

此外，可能还需要知道每层的房间布局？但用户只说两层住宅，没有指定房间数量或布局。按照最少信息原则，我们可以假设整个楼层是一个大空间？但为了生成IFC，需要定义空间的形状和大小。平面尺寸是必需的。所以问清楚。
